method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly).
overview: Axion Ray is a New York AI startup whose software helps manufacturers' engineering teams detect, investigate and resolve product-quality issues; customers include Boeing, Pratt & Whitney, Baxter and DENSO. It raised a $37m Series B led by Salesforce Ventures in December 2025.

differentiators.text: Customer-facing 'AI Deployment Strategist' roles combine business problem-solving with rolling out AI at Fortune 500 manufacturers.
differentiators.significance: Consulting-like client work inside a startup; pay includes equity and commission.

tradeoffs.text: Early-stage company (Series B): roles change quickly and formal training is limited.
